title: Robin 101
novel:
After Barney started dating Robin, Ted decided to help. He created a [[course|course]] called Robin 101, complete with a [[syllabus|syllabus]] and a blackboard full of notes.

"Robin [[hates|hate]] being asked about her father," Ted [[explained|explain]]. "She loves [[challenge|challenge]]. She never admits she is wrong."

Barney took [[diligent|diligent]] notes, treating the lesson like a [[sacred|sacred]] text. But Robin discovered what they were doing, and she was [[furious|furious]].

"You two are treating me like a [[specimen|specimen]]," she said.

Ted felt a flash of [[guilt|guilt]]. He had meant well, but he had [[betrayed|betray]] her trust. The [[secrets|secret]] he shared were not his to tell.

That night Ted [[apologized|apologize]] to Robin. "I was trying to help Barney, but I went too far."

Robin [[sighed|sigh]]. "Some things you only learn by living them," she said.

Ted understood. To truly love someone meant letting them [[stumble|stumble]] on their own. He could not write a [[manual|manual]] for another person's heart.

course.en: a series of lessons on a subject

syllabus.en: a list of the subjects taught in a course

hate.en: to dislike someone or something very much

explain.en: to make something clear to someone

challenge.en: something difficult that tests your ability

diligent.en: showing care and effort in your work

sacred.en: very important and treated with great respect

guilt.en: the bad feeling that you have done wrong

betray.en: to hurt someone who trusts you

secret.en: something that only a few people know

apologize.en: to tell someone you are sorry

sigh.en: to breathe out slowly, showing sadness or relief

stumble.en: to make a mistake while doing something

manual.en: a book that tells you how to do something
